answer: Ivory melts in the fire at the summit, and an identity that holds no tusk may not act. A sparrow carries each holder's tusks up there, and the flock takes from every identity as many tusks as the holder keeps identities, each season. An honest newcomer loses one tusk a season; a keeper of a thousand identities loses a thousand each, a million tusks a season, and a million tusks of ivory locked at once. The tablet keeps one line per funding root, so forks and fresh wallets melt just as fast.
